_how_to_use: Owner's settings for the Japanese Gold Star screener. Confirmed 14 October 2026; scope changed by the owner on 15 October 2026 (in chat). Never change a setting the owner did not confirm. The screener runs when the owner asks (project skill 'gold-stars'), not on a schedule.

market.category: Pokémon graded cards (specific cards only, no sealed products)
buying_regions: Europe first, any country (Spain not required); Spain and the rest of the European Union with no import costs
Non-EU Europe, e.g. United Kingdom: every import cost itemised
Rest of the world only when a card has no European listing: every import cost itemised
market.card_list: Japanese Gold Stars only (screener/cards.json); the 82 all-cards searches are archived in screener/old_all_cards_screener

priority_group.name: Japanese Gold Star Play promos
priority_group.note: Only the Play promos. NOT the World Championships cards that came in packs.
priority_group.search_scope: Europe first; worldwide if no European listing
priority_group.report_first: Every morning message and the top of the dashboard open with this group: new listings since the previous night and where, or 'none new'.
priority_group.to_do_at_build: find each card's PriceCharting page (graded and ungraded prices) and write its search entries in the searches.json shape

schedule.mode: on demand (owner runs it); no scheduled task
schedule.note: the earlier daily 10:00 schedule was dropped on 15 October 2026

ebay_pacing.on_error_page: wait 20 minutes, retry once, then stop reading eBay for the night

filters.title_exact_item_number_grader_grade: required, except grader and grade for the priority group (ungraded allowed)
filters.unreadable_label: never rule out: mark 'Slab label not readable' for the owner to check
filters.seller_words_exception: 'ungraded' does not rule out a priority-group listing

costs_to_resource_at_setup: eBay Buyer Protection fee for Spain (ebay.es)
insured postage service and prices for resale from Spain
import duty, Spanish VAT and carrier handling fee for goods from outside the European Union
European Central Bank exchange rates (fetched daily)

price_source.confirmed: 15 October 2026, by the owner in chat
price_source.why: PriceCharting refuses automated reading (HTTP 403 and a Cloudflare security check, 14 October 2026); eBay sold listings on ebay.es and ebay.com require signing in. Listings are found, checked and costed, but carry no market value, profit or Buy / Offer / Auction signal.
options_later: PriceCharting subscription with an API key
the owner signs in to ebay.es in the browser (not recommended)

certificates.psacard_com: blocked by a security check (14 October 2026)
certificates.psa_api_key: optional: the owner's free PSA account key saved as data/psa_token.txt enables certificate checks (100 a day)

scope_15_october_2026.focus: Japanese Gold Star (☆) cards only; all other cards dropped
scope_15_october_2026.priority: The five Japanese Gold Star Play promos: Vaporeon 022/PLAY, Jolteon 023/PLAY, Flareon 024/PLAY, Espeon 025/PLAY and Umbreon 026/PLAY (Players Club, 2005-2006; Espeon and Umbreon added by the owner on 15 October 2026). Vaporeon, Jolteon and Flareon count ONLY as these Play promos (their World Champions Pack cards 015, 027 and 011 of 108 are not tracked); the Umbreon 25th Anniversary reprint 012/025 is not tracked
scope_15_october_2026.other_gold_stars: every other Japanese Gold Star is shown too; unlimited prints ranked above 1st Edition
scope_15_october_2026.naming: titles can be wrong in both directions: listings of the five Play promos on free-text sites are checked on their photo, and the photo decides
sites: GempireCards (gempirecards.com): eBay worldwide including sellers that do not ship to Spain, plus ALT, Fanatics Collect and Goldin auctions; owner's double check for eBay, added 15 October 2026
Yahoo! Auctions Japan through Buyee (Yahoo blocks European Union visitors; Buyee's search pages are readable, added 15 October 2026)

sites_not_readable.Yahoo! Auctions Japan: blocked for European Union visitors since 2022; read through Buyee instead
sites_not_readable.Cardmarket: Cloudflare security check in Claude's browser (checked again 15 October 2026); not bypassed. Could be read in the owner's own Chrome if the owner agrees

scope_15_october_2026.run: on demand: every time the owner runs it, all sites are searched and the dashboard shows new listings, listings seen before (with price changes) and listings no longer found, each with price and link
scope_15_october_2026.price_limit: none for Gold Stars (the 8,000 EUR band applied to the earlier all-cards screener)
scope_15_october_2026.card_list: screener/cards.json (27 cards; sources: Bulbapedia, Bill's Archive, Card Rush, checked 15 October 2026)
scope_15_october_2026.search_depth: owner, 15 October 2026 (Jolteon listings missed): several search terms per Play promo on every site, eBay searched both by newest and by best match, Mercari search pages scrolled to the end and truncated titles opened on the listing page

shipping_to_spain.owner_request: each listing shows whether it ships to Spain and how (15 October 2026)
